title: Sunday Quick Tip
subtitle: Notes after practice
hook: What did you learn from your last practice?
intro: Practice ends and you drive home.
By next week you have forgotten what worked.
statement: A few notes make the next practice better.
q1: Do you jot down quick notes after each practice —
q2: or keep it in your head and plan fresh each time?
q3: Which drill worked better than expected?
t1: Both can work. But practices improve
ctaLines: A phone note. A notebook. Nothing at all.
ctaPrompt: Share your habit below. There are no wrong answers.
caption:
What did you learn from your last practice?
Practice ends and you drive home. By next week you have forgotten what worked.
A few notes make the next practice better.
Quick notes or memory. There is no perfect answer.
Do you keep notes? Share your habit in the comments.
